//: Frontline iOS — EAS Build config. Bundle ID app.frontline.intel, Apple Team LMNGCLUC3S (reused from Happy Hour Live; the BUNDLE ID is NOT reused and is NOT yet registered — see DECISIONS.md item 2). No secrets/credentials live here: everything sensitive is referenced by NAME via EAS secrets / env and resolved at build time. See ios/README.md for the operator runbook.

build.//: Three profiles mirroring a standard Capacitor + EAS setup. All iOS. The web bundle is produced with BUILD_TARGET=capacitor (Next static export -> out/) then `cap sync ios` copies it into the native shell before EAS compiles it.

preview.//: Ad-hoc / internal distribution build for on-device QA. This is the profile CI runs. It produces an installable .ipa but DOES NOT submit to TestFlight.

production.//: App Store / TestFlight-eligible build. Building this artifact is allowed; SUBMITTING it is the gated step (see eas submit config below and DECISIONS.md item 5).

submit.//: GATED — do not run `eas submit` without explicit approval (DECISIONS.md item 5). Values are referenced by NAME only and must be supplied as EAS secrets at submit time; none are embedded here. Required secrets: EXPO_APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD or an App Store Connect API key (ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8) — see ios/README.md.
